comments.text:
Galaxy 1 has a much more grand and atmospheric feel whereas galaxy 2 has a larger focus on bite-sized ideas.
I think this is both a strength and a weakness of the second game; quite a few of the levels would be even better if they were fleshed out fully the way the galaxies in the first game were and then quite a few other levels felt boring or like they were just in the game as filler (worlds 6 & S specifically)
I love both games but coming off a very recent replay of both, i can confidently say that Galaxy 1 is still my favorite game of all time.
